meta.title: Codex body effects (optional)
meta.description: Replace the bottom Deep diving indicator with a top Worked elapsed-time header and divider. Add a gray moving highlight to active operations, disclosure motion, and Codex-like pencil and terminal icons. Hide live reasoning content while retaining DSH's completed reasoning disclosure and icon. Keep real messages, tool details, approvals, and file actions. On by default; requires the Codex UI component. Switching off restores DSH's original body presentation.
